title: Chartered Speed IPO
summary: Chartered Speed IPO is a ₹430 crore book-built issue, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Chartered Speed IPO has a total issue size of 430 crore and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd., SBI Capital Markets Ltd.

b.p: Data sourced from DRHP / RHP • For educational purposes only
Chartered Speed financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Chartered Speed is one of the most prominent passenger mobility service providers in India, with more than 2,000 buses as of June 30, 2025. The firm provides both inter-city and intra-city transport services in six states. Intra-city bus operations for Chartered Speed increased to more than 620 buses by June 30, 2025, which operate in the states of Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh. · · Business Model: · Annuity model: Long-term agreement with state transport corporations, government supported organizations, and institutions. The total number of buses used under the Annuity model is 1,382 buses as of March 31, 2025. · Ticket revenue model: Income from ticket sales. The firm has an average daily trips of 258 and average daily passengers of 8,400 as of March 31, 2025.
Pankaj Gandhi, Alka Pankaj Gandhi, Sanyam Gandhi are the company's promoters of Chartered Speed.
